Shape: one file deleted (`tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_budget.py` — both tests are the retired step floor; the completion-side floor stays covered by `test_completion_budget.py`'s `verify_step_floor` / `_VERIFY_STEP_FLOOR_MAX`), one renamed (`test_review_as_workflow.py` to `test_runner_agent_step_bridge.py`, keeping `:21`), the remainder rewritten against `spec_scan.scan_epics_for_spec` (the structural sibling: same `gate_source` threading, `cfg.repo_path` prompt resolution, `runner=` seam), the prompt id swapped to `code-quality` in stand-in uses, and golden sets dropping it.

Two sites are called out here because they are easy to under-apply. First, `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` has FOUR coupled `_review_ticket_impl` sites that must go together: the live-call test `:102-122`; the `_UNFOLLOWABLE` registry entry `:247-257` (leaving it fails `test_neither_registry_has_stale_entries:600`, which asserts `set(_UNFOLLOWABLE) <= unresolved`); the run-request row `:486`; and the count at `:532`, where `assert len(_EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES) == 21` becomes `== 20`. Second, `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py:181` carries the `ticket-quality` prompt id and must be swapped to `code-quality`: `tests/external` is inside AC1's grep scope and is not in its exclude list, so AC1 fails without it.
